jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.description:
At BuildOps, we build software for modern commercial contractors, from service management through project delivery. We care deeply about the mission and look for people who are driven, self motivated, and excited by fast moving, high ownership environments.



Data sits at the center of BuildOps' AI first strategy. The operational data our customers generate on BuildOps is a long term advantage, but only if it is clean, reliable, and well governed. As Director of Engineering, Data, you will build and lead our unified Data \& AI engineering function. You will own the platforms, pipelines, quality standards, and operating discipline that power AI and ML products and help customers trust BuildOps as their system of record.



Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will help define BuildOps' data strategy over the next three to five years and shape how we build data powered products. This is a foundational leadership role for someone who can think long term about architecture while staying close to the work. You have built and scaled data organizations before and know how to take a team from early stage scrappiness to operational excellence.


**What You'll Do**


* Own BuildOps' data platform and architecture end to end, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and an ML and streaming strategy that evolves with the business and scales efficiently
* Build scalable, repeatable customer and partner data onboarding capabilities that bring data into BuildOps quickly and reliably, reducing time to first value
* Run data systems with production grade discipline, including monitoring, alerting, SLAs, incident response, lineage, freshness, and clear ownership for critical datasets
* Create the data foundation required for AI and ML products, with accurate, well documented inputs today and the right training, inference, and feature infrastructure as those products mature
* Establish governance that supports speed, including access controls, data classification, audit trails, PII handling, and practical data contracts that teams can depend on
* Hire, develop, and lead a strong data engineering team, and establish the right operating rhythms across planning, on call, and stakeholder intake


**What We Look For**


* 10\+ years in data or software engineering, including experience building and scaling teams of 10\+ engineers, with a track record of hiring well, growing leaders, and leading through managers as well as individual contributors
* Deep hands on experience with modern data platforms, including a cloud warehouse or lakehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt and ELT patterns, orchestration tools like Airflow, and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis, with AWS experience strongly preferred
* Direct experience building data systems that support production ML use cases, not just analytics, with an understanding of feature stores, training data, real time inference, and the tradeoffs involved in building versus buying ML platform capabilities
* A track record of operational excellence in data, including monitoring, SLAs, incident response, and data quality practices applied with the same rigor as customer facing systems
* Experience delivering customer facing data products such as reporting, analytics, or APIs in B2B SaaS environments where performance, reliability, and trust matter
* Strong architectural judgment, including when to build, when to buy, how to design for change, and how to sequence investments behind validated needs instead of overbuilding
* A pragmatic approach to governance, with security and compliance built in, documentation and contracts that stay current, and access models that balance control with self service
* Early stage or scale up experience in Series B through D companies is a plus, and experience in vertical SaaS or construction tech is helpful but not required


**Who You Are**


* A builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and greenfield work, and can move quickly, ship an MVP, and still make sound decisions for long term scale
* Both hands on and strategic, willing to write code, debug issues, and carry operational responsibility when needed while maintaining a clear multi year vision
* You know how to influence across Product, Engineering, GTM, Finance, and the executive team, build trust, communicate clearly, and push back when priorities are misaligned
* Able to translate technical decisions into business impact and business goals into technical direction
* You have seen this stage of growth before and know what good looks like in a high growth data organization


**Compensation**


* $176,000 \- $235,000 base salary range \+ annual bonus \+ meaningful equity

**What we offer:**
* Generous equity grant, become an owner in our company!
* A comprehensive benefits package
* Flexible PTO and hybrid work schedules
* One\-time work\-from\-home allowance
* Hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Toronto, and Raleigh with hybrid work schedules and lunch provided for in\-office days
* Company events and team\-building activities, both in\-person and virtual
* Fast\-paced, collaborative, and dynamic work environment
* Opportunities for growth and career advancement
* Chance to work with cutting\-edge technology and innovative solutions
* The chance to get in on the ground floor and build something truly groundbreaking for ourselves and our amazing customers


*We welcome applicants from across the U.S. where we are registered to do business and able to support employment. Currently, this excludes the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Kentucky, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. This list is based solely on operational and compliance considerations and is reviewed from time to time as our footprint grows.*

Join BuildOps, the largest commercial trade platform in the country, as we transform the multi\-billion dollar commercial contracting industry!

jobs.title: Director, Transformation & AI Delivery
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What You’ll Be Doing**  



As the Director, Transformation \& AI Delivery, you will be reporting to the Senior Director, Strategy, Business Management and Effectiveness in Transaction Banking. In this role you will lead Transaction Banking’s transformation and AI agenda by overseeing the full portfolio of process transformation and AI initiatives while directly owning and delivering a significant portion of them. You will be establishing governance frameworks, maintaining clear visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and resourcing, as well as preparing updates for leadership and steering committees. You will also be identifying and prioritizing new transformation and AI opportunities, leading initiatives from idea through design, build, launch, and adoption, and ensuring measurable business outcomes are defined and realized.  



  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.*

  

**How You'll Succeed**  



* **PMO and Governance \-** Establish and run a single framework for intake, prioritization, stage gates, status reporting, and benefits tracking. Maintain a current view of initiative status, risks, dependencies, and resourcing. Run weekly workstream check\-ins and bi\-weekly portfolio working sessions. Prepare monthly status reports for TB leadership and quarterly steering committee and benefits reviews. Represent TB in enterprise transformation and AI governance forums.
  

* **Initiative Identification and Delivery \-** Build a structured pipeline to find, assess, and prioritize process transformation and AI opportunities. Lead owned initiatives from ideation and solution design through build, launch, and adoption. Define benefits at the outset (efficiency, cost, revenue, risk) and report realized outcomes after launch.
  

* **Stakeholder Leadership** \- Align Technology, Data and AI, Operations, Product, Risk, Compliance, Model Risk, and Finance on priorities and decisions. Mobilize and direct matrixed resources, and escalate risks and decisions early. Drive change management and adoption so results are sustained.
  

* **Success Outcomes** \- Success will be demonstrated by strong transformation governance across the portfolio, clear and current visibility for senior leadership, end\-to\-end delivery of owned initiatives with measurable impact, and a repeatable pipeline of process transformation and AI opportunities. It will also include benefits that are clearly defined, tracked, and realized, as well as strong stakeholder alignment and sustained adoption.
  

* **Collaboration \& Culture** \- Foster a culture of collaboration and innovation within the team and across partner groups, including Commercial Banking and Transaction Banking teams.
  

**Who You Are**  



* **You can demonstrate 8\-10 years of experience** in banking, financial services, or consulting, with exposure to payments or transaction banking or cash management as well as hands\-on AI/GenAI transformation or delivery experience. It is an asset if you have PMO or portfolio governance experience and benefits realization experience.
* **Your influence makes a difference.** You have a proven track record leading complex, cross\-functional programs through influence, with strong executive communication.
* **You look beyond the moment.** You know what you do will make a difference today and tomorrow. You look for new opportunities to define what's possible. Change management and adoption experience would be an asset.
* **You embrace and advocate for change.** You have experience building an idea or opportunity pipeline, including process transformation or automation.
* **You live your values.** You bring high standards, genuine care to your relationships, and want to grow with an employer that shares your values and brings out your best.

\#LI\-TA


**What CIBC Offers**

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


* We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program\*, defined benefit pension plan\*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
* Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
* We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

jobs.title: Director/Senior Director Technology Audit and Advisory Services
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


The Director/Senior Director Technology Audit and Advisory Services is accountable for the delivery of high quality, professional, cost\-effective, value\-added, and risk\-based internal audit services over Technology functions, across North America (Canada and US Segment), Global Wealth \& Asset Management, Group Functions, and the Global Data Technology Office. The role reports to the AVP of North America Segment Technology, Audit Services.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities:**


* Audit Delivery – Delivery of North America Segment Technology, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity (steady state/key risk, program and project, business integrated, issue assessments).
* Technology SOX – Delivery of application and infrastructure technology SOX audit work and to drive our approach and processes for this work forward through use of automation, data analytics, and shared services.
* Reporting and Planning – Execution and continuous improvement of reporting processes in support of the larger technology audit organization, as well as annual audit planning, resource management, and other process improvements for the immediate North America segment technology audit team.
* Other – Audit initiatives, engagements, and process improvements as assigned.
  

  

**Strategic Leadership**


* Understand the company’s strategy, operations, and regulatory environment to proactively identify areas of emerging and heightened risk related to technology that affects the company
* Support the development of an audit strategy that aligns to business, technology, and Audit Services strategies, provides sufficient coverage for key risks while meeting regulatory expectations
* Develop internal procedures and tools to drive consistency across all engagements and drive audit planning
* Help improve Technology SOX delivery and quality to improve efficiencies through increased use of data analytics, automation and shared services and other innovations
* Develop and produce meaningful reports for Senior Technology Management that identify trends and enable continuous improvement of risks and controls
* Contribute to the development of Audit Services procedures, strategy, and direction; continually improve audit and supporting processes leveraging technology to the fullest
  

  

**Audit Delivery and Oversight**


* Plan and direct audits and special audit projects to objectively evaluate the effectiveness of key controls and adequacy of risk management practices; collaborating with management to obtain a consensus on establishing the problem, risks exposure; produce meaningful audit reports that clearly articulate the position on risks and related issues, while meeting Audit Services operational targets related to budget, timeline and quality of execution
* Delivery of annual Technology Application and Infrastructure ITGC SOX work, in collaboration with Technology Management, SOX PMO, and external audit
* Perform integrated/cross\-functional audits in partnership with groups across Audit Services to provide comprehensive reporting on risks that could prevent the achievement of Management’s objectives
* Support the development of an annual audit plan using risk management processes, in collaboration with Management and Audit Services leadership
* Drive innovation and incorporate and develop industry best practices into forward thinking audit approach; manage Audit Services’ resources efficiently, economically, and effectively
* Provide management with timely recommendations that reduce risk, help them run their business better, make strategic and operational decisions, and oversee management of risks and controls
* Monitoring progress in implementing control recommendations and reporting thereon; assist with preparation of Audit Committee and senior leadership reports
  

**Leadership \& People Development**


* Lead and develop a high\-caliber audit team, attract, and retain top talent and provide appropriate development, coaching and training
* Foster creative culture that strives for continuous improvement and welcomes and offers feedback—enabling best\-in\-class audit practices
* Challenge, coach and enable the team members to develop to their fullest and maximize their contribution to the team
* Drive team skills development and engagement; manage talent across the team for development and succession and rotate change expertise
  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Managing Management’s expectations regarding assurance and advisory work deadlines and deliverables
* Providing relevant stakeholders with an overview of audit work and commentary on the control environment, including trends and emerging issues that could impact the Company
* Collaborate effectively with divisional and global stakeholders in Technology and Information Risk Management
* Establishing a high level of credibility and building professional relationships with key stakeholders responsible for technology and information risk across the Company
  

**Required Qualifications:**


* Exceptional communications judgement and the ability to communicate clearly and succinctly to effectively deliver key messages verbally and in writing and to listen and consider various perspectives; confident presentation and facilitation skills and strong interpersonal and leadership skills to facilitate working with senior management at all levels
* Ability to quickly understand business processes and risks, identify key controls, analyze complex situations, reach appropriate conclusions, make value\-added and practical recommendations and influence management to take appropriate actions on recommendations
* In\-depth knowledge of audit methodologies, project management and system development methodologies (including Agile), control frameworks and risk management practices, and regulatory requirements; Exceptional understanding of how technology supports business strategies, the latest technology and cyber security trends, best practices

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Process & Business Readiness *** Directeur(ice), Processus d'entreprise et préparation opérationnelle
jobs.description:
At IPEX, the leader in thermoplastic piping systems, we are redefining the future of water management and clean energy. As part of the Aliaxis family, we combine global strength with local expertise to tackle the world's toughest challenges. Guided by our values – We Care, We Dare, We Deliver – we challenge the status quo to make a meaningful impact. If you're an innovative collaborator ready to make a difference, come join us in shaping a better tomorrow!  



  

**Job Summary**

The Director, Enterprise Process \& Business Readiness is accountable for leading the business transformation activities required to successfully deploy SAP across the enterprise’s manufacturing and distribution network.  



Reporting to the VP, ERP Business Transformation, this role serves as the senior business counterpart to the Director of ERP Delivery and is responsible for ensuring the organization is operationally prepared for the ERP deployment through process standardization, stakeholder alignment, organizational readiness, and deployment governance.  



The role partners closely with the Director, ERP Change \& Training, Director, Data Governance \& Management, Business Process Owners, Functional Leaders, Site Leadership Teams, and IT to drive adoption of standardized SAP\-enabled business processes across IPEX’s manufacturing plants and distribution centres.  



The Director leads the enterprise\-wide efforts to establish consistent operating practices, collaborate in the transformation of operational master data, mobilize business resources, and implement objective readiness measures that ensure successful deployment and business continuity during cutover and go\-live.  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Process Transformation**

* Lead enterprise process transformation by establishing the future\-state business process model, leveraging SAP standard capabilities, leading practices and simplification opportunities
* Dotted line partner with the Business Process Owners (BPOs) to document, sustain, and deploy future\-state processes
* Establish governance mechanisms to ensure adherence to standardized processes and minimize local customization
* Drive alignment between enterprise process standards and site\-level operational requirements
* Resolve conflicts between local business practices and enterprise process design
* Facilitate process harmonization workshops with functional and operational leadership teams
* Ensure process design decisions support scalability, compliance, operational efficiency and SAP standard functionality
* Own business governance, quality, and stewardship of operational master data across assigned process domains.
* Approve and prioritize master data changes, ensuring compliance with data standards, controls, and business requirements.
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and IT teams to define, maintain, and continuously improve master data processes and controls.

**Business Readiness**

* Develop and execute the enterprise business readiness strategy for ERP deployment
* Identify points of failure, risks, business contingency plans, and the metrics that trigger identified contingencies
* Develop key tactics to alter timing of typical business rhythms by advancing or deferring core activities or operations
* Plan daily operations to compensate for reduced staffing during training period
* Develop and deploy operational targets (KPIs), monitoring methods, and reporting cadence
* Collaborate on planning staffing levels to compensate for loss of efficiency during Hypercare
* Ensure employees understand any role or responsibility changes
* Determine key user and backfill needs; outline coverage and working schedule
* Support external business partners on key actions and dates to align changes within their operations
* Identify operational leader roles for Cutover and Hypercare coverage
* Identify leaders responsible for cascading information
* Create opportunities to share transparent, timely updates
* Identify potential roadblocks to successful transfer to Business ownership
* Plan supervisors’ daily activities post\-Go Live to support new ways of working and identify issues early
* Drive stakeholder engagement across manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, customer service, finance and commercial functions
* Build commitment and ownership among operational leaders for adopting for adopting new ways of working
* Lead readiness reviews with executive stakeholders and deployment governance teams
* Partner with Operational Change Management \& Training to ensure training, process adoption, organizational readiness, and business ownership are achieved before deployment

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business; MBA considered beneficial
* 10\-15 years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, operations, ERP transformation, or operational excellence
* Proven experience leading large\-scale, multi\-year ERP deployments, preferably SAP
* Experience deploying standardized business processes across multiple manufacturing locations
* Experience establishing operational master data governance and quality programs
* Experience influencing senior leaders across operational and functional organizations
* Demonstrated success leading enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives

IPEX is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities throughout the recruitment process and, upon request, will work with qualified job applicants to provide suitable accommodation in a manner that takes into account the applicant’s accessibility needs due to disability. Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at HR@ipexna.com

At CBC/Radio\-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.
  

  

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever\-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

**Headwaters Health Care Centre. One Community, Caring Together.**
------------------------------------------------------------------


At **Headwaters Health Care Centre,** we are proud to serve our community with compassion, accountability, and teamwork. We are seeking a **Director, Finance and Health Records** who is motivated by purpose, values collaboration, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a community hospital setting.


**About the Role**


Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Services and Chief Financial Officer, this senior leadership role provides strategic and operational oversight for Finance, Health Records, Materials Management, and hospital‑owned medical office buildings. The Director plays a critical role in advancing financial sustainability, strengthening data‑informed decision‑making, and ensuring the integrity and accessibility of health information that supports high‑quality patient care.


As a trusted partner to clinical and corporate leaders, the Director leads core financial functions including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, audits, procurement, and internal controls, while also championing excellence in health information management, privacy, and digital health optimization. The role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to organizational strategy, quality improvement, and collaboration across the broader health system, while supporting the operational and financial performance of commercial rental facilities located on hospital property.


This is an ideal opportunity for a principled, forward‑thinking leader who enjoys working in a dynamic environment, values collaboration, and is passionate about using financial and information stewardship to enable excellent care.


**What You’ll Do**


* Provide strategic leadership for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and audits
* Champion excellence by leading and supporting high‑quality health records, privacy, data integrity, and digital health systems
* Oversee procurement and materials management in alignment with public‑sector best practices and with a focus on stewardship and transparency
* Manage the financial and operational performance of hospital‑owned medical office buildings
* Partner with leaders to assess risks, develop business cases, and drive continuous improvement
* Support Board, committee, and external reporting relationships with clarity and accountability
* Lead, mentor, and develop high‑performing teams, fostering engagement, growth and building strong succession and talent pipelines
  

**What You Bring**


You are a principled and collaborative leader who brings both professional expertise and a strong commitment to public service and patient‑centred care.


* A commitment to public service and patient‑centred care, grounded in integrity, accountability, and collaboration
* Progressive senior‑level financial leadership experience in a hospital or complex health‑care environment
* A CPA designation, with strong expertise in financial planning, reporting, audits, and stewardship of public resources
* The ability to translate financial, clinical, and operational data into meaningful insights that support decision‑making
* Experience leading or supporting large‑scale information system implementations and digital optimization initiatives
* A people‑centred leadership style, with a proven ability to engage, develop, and inspire high‑performing teams
* Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort navigating complexity and change
* A collaborative mindset, with experience working in unionized environments and partnering across the health system
  

  

**Hours of Work:** 37\.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday
  

  

**Hiring Salary Range:** $160,602 \- $188,955  

  



We are currently hiring for an existing vacancy.


**Why Headwaters?**
  

  

At **Headwaters Health Care Centre**, you’ll be part of a purpose‑driven organization where your leadership directly supports patient care and community well‑being. We offer the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a community hospital setting while working alongside dedicated, values‑driven professionals.
  

  

You’ll join a collaborative leadership team committed to accountability, continuous improvement, and thoughtful stewardship of public resources. At Headwaters, your expertise will be valued, your voice will matter, and your work will contribute to a trusted, high‑quality health system that serves today’s needs while planning responsibly for the future.  



We offer a wide range of employee perks, for information on our comprehensive benefits package, please visit **Headwaters Health Care Centre \- Careers at Headwaters** .
  

  

We thank all those who apply but only those individuals selected for further consideration will be contacted.
  

  

Headwaters Health Care Centre is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and supports the compliance of the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you have a need for an accommodation, please contact Human Resources so that appropriate arrangements can be made.
  

  

Headwaters Health Care Centre is a smoke\-free facility. Smoking is not permitted on hospital properties. We thank everyone who works at or visits our hospitals for respecting this healthy initiative. We are also a scent\-free environment for all employees and visitors.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274835
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

Global Transaction Banking

  

  

Global Transaction Banking (GTB) is the payments and transaction engine of Scotiabank. We support Small Business, Commercial and Corporate clients with effective treasury management solutions coupled with a best\-in\-class service model, making it easy for clients to do business with us.  



  

As businesses build their digital capabilities and transform their operating models, their payment needs are evolving too. Boasting a unique global footprint, GTB’s comprehensive suite of innovative banking solutions help our business clients generate operational efficiencies, streamline and simplify payments, improve working capital performance, and mitigate financial risk.  



  

At Scotiabank, we embrace your strengths, ideas, and ambitions. GTB is a fast\-growing team with a focus on the Americas, particularly Canada, the U.S., Mexico, and we are seeking top tier talent to complement our organization.  



  

Join a purpose\-driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

**Headwaters Health Care Centre. One Community, Caring Together.**
------------------------------------------------------------------


At **Headwaters Health Care Centre,** we are proud to serve our community with compassion, accountability, and teamwork. We are seeking a **Director, Finance and Health Records** who is motivated by purpose, values collaboration, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a community hospital setting.


**About the Role**


Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Services and Chief Financial Officer, this senior leadership role provides strategic and operational oversight for Finance, Health Records, Materials Management, and hospital‑owned medical office buildings. The Director plays a critical role in advancing financial sustainability, strengthening data‑informed decision‑making, and ensuring the integrity and accessibility of health information that supports high‑quality patient care.


As a trusted partner to clinical and corporate leaders, the Director leads core financial functions including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, audits, procurement, and internal controls, while also championing excellence in health information management, privacy, and digital health optimization. The role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to organizational strategy, quality improvement, and collaboration across the broader health system, while supporting the operational and financial performance of commercial rental facilities located on hospital property.


This is an ideal opportunity for a principled, forward‑thinking leader who enjoys working in a dynamic environment, values collaboration, and is passionate about using financial and information stewardship to enable excellent care.


**What You’ll Do**


* Provide strategic leadership for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and audits
* Champion excellence by leading and supporting high‑quality health records, privacy, data integrity, and digital health systems
* Oversee procurement and materials management in alignment with public‑sector best practices and with a focus on stewardship and transparency
* Manage the financial and operational performance of hospital‑owned medical office buildings
* Partner with leaders to assess risks, develop business cases, and drive continuous improvement
* Support Board, committee, and external reporting relationships with clarity and accountability
* Lead, mentor, and develop high‑performing teams, fostering engagement, growth and building strong succession and talent pipelines
  

**What You Bring**


You are a principled and collaborative leader who brings both professional expertise and a strong commitment to public service and patient‑centred care.


* A commitment to public service and patient‑centred care, grounded in integrity, accountability, and collaboration
* Progressive senior‑level financial leadership experience in a hospital or complex health‑care environment
* A CPA designation, with strong expertise in financial planning, reporting, audits, and stewardship of public resources
* The ability to translate financial, clinical, and operational data into meaningful insights that support decision‑making
* Experience leading or supporting large‑scale information system implementations and digital optimization initiatives
* A people‑centred leadership style, with a proven ability to engage, develop, and inspire high‑performing teams
* Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort navigating complexity and change
* A collaborative mindset, with experience working in unionized environments and partnering across the health system
  

  

**Hours of Work:** 37\.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday
  

  

**Hiring Salary Range:** $160,602 \- $188,955  

  



We are currently hiring for an existing vacancy.


**Why Headwaters?**
  

  

At **Headwaters Health Care Centre**, you’ll be part of a purpose‑driven organization where your leadership directly supports patient care and community well‑being. We offer the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a community hospital setting while working alongside dedicated, values‑driven professionals.
  

  

You’ll join a collaborative leadership team committed to accountability, continuous improvement, and thoughtful stewardship of public resources. At Headwaters, your expertise will be valued, your voice will matter, and your work will contribute to a trusted, high‑quality health system that serves today’s needs while planning responsibly for the future.  



We offer a wide range of employee perks, for information on our comprehensive benefits package, please visit **Headwaters Health Care Centre \- Careers at Headwaters** .
  

  

We thank all those who apply but only those individuals selected for further consideration will be contacted.
  

  

Headwaters Health Care Centre is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and supports the compliance of the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you have a need for an accommodation, please contact Human Resources so that appropriate arrangements can be made.
  

  

Headwaters Health Care Centre is a smoke\-free facility. Smoking is not permitted on hospital properties. We thank everyone who works at or visits our hospitals for respecting this healthy initiative. We are also a scent\-free environment for all employees and visitors.
